metadata.name: Offline KV rounding and attention attribution

limitations: FP64 attention is a shared diagnostic kernel, not an independent replacement network oracle or release criterion.
Shapley contributions exactly decompose a local matched-kernel output difference, not final-logit error or model-quality causation.
Only targetrow has pre-FP16 K/V captures; allprefix canonicalKV exists but its allrow precast values were not captured.
No conclusion about failed64/2048 fixtures follows without separate matched captures.

Used original trace artifacts are checked directly against prior identity-qualified analysis hashes; unrelated later runtime-source changes are not retroactively checked as if these traces came from current code.
